title: Florida v. Bostick (1991)
key_points: Holding: Approaching people and asking questions or for consent is not a seizure if a reasonable person would feel free to decline or end the encounter.
officer_notes: Scenario: You board a bus at a terminal and politely ask passengers for permission to search their bags, telling them they can refuse.
Takeaway: Keep field inquiries non-coercive: no blocking exits, no demands, no retained ID.
